propositions: set_project accepts invalid project keys (empty string, syntactically malformed, trailing whitespace) with no validation and writes them to projects.json, causing failures downstream in reconciler fan-out
set_project and remove_project must validate project keys using the existing fetcher._validate_project_key regex before writing to projects.json or performing mutations
invalid project keys must raise ValueError before fsutil.atomic_write/commit_and_push_tickets_branch, preventing file persistence or publishing
invalid-key ValueError must map to RebarError(returncode=2) at the _lib_ops seam (bridge_projects_set/remove) for consistent error handling across CLI and MCP write tools
valid keys (matching ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$) must continue to be accepted and written unchanged through the existing atomic RMW path
validation must be syntactic only; no live Jira/network calls or existence checks
